verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature lets users describe a job in plain language and trigger it on a schedule or event, and 'Skills' let teams standardize recurring workflows—both no-code automation constructs usable by a PM (linear-docs-11, linear-docs-36, linear-docs-23, linear-docs-46). However, the docs don't clearly show a visual multi-step builder (branching logic, chained actions) as in dedicated automation tools; most automation is framed around agent-assisted single jobs. Missing for 10: explicit multi-step/branching workflow builder UI, independent/hands-on evidence of complex automations, and clarity on non-agent rule-based automation depth.
